title: MY TROUBLES ARE MANY
stanzas: My trouble are many, and my pleasures are few, I guess life is always that way, but i can't complain cause I know I will be free when I get to heaven someday.
Sometime I get weary I don't know where O stand, I stumble and I fall on the way but Jesus has promised to reach out His hand, O know I'll get to heaven someday
My friends can't believe me, when I say it is true, that somewhere there is a home made for me, it is made of gold and there is one made for you, come we meet in heaven and see.
chorus: But tell where am I now, am I almost there is that heaven's bright glory I see, Is that Jesus I hear calling out my name, the door standing open for me.
